title: Why One Of Your Car Mirrors Comes With A Warning

scenes.narration: On an American car the passenger side mirror is curved, the driver's side one is flat, and only the curved one carries a warning printed on the glass.
scenes.note: The asymmetry is the hook: two mirrors on one car, only one carrying text. US-specific and the script says so.

beats.action: both wing mirrors draw in side by side, seen from the driver seat
the passenger mirror bulges visibly; the driver mirror stays flat
the warning text appears along the bottom of the curved one and circles teal
the curved mirror bulges a little further against the flat one
beats.sync: secondary action — closes a pacing gap

scenes.narration: Curving a mirror squeezes a wider slice of road into the same piece of glass, which is how it covers a blind spot a flat mirror cannot reach.
scenes.note: The optics, from above. A wider cone entering the same glass — and the blind spot it covers.

beats.action: top-down: a flat mirror reflects a narrow cone of road
the mirror curves; the cone widens dramatically into the same glass
a shaded blind spot beside the car is swallowed by the wider cone
the widened cone sweeps back along the road
beats.sync: secondary action — closes a pacing gap

beats.action: the swallowed blind spot shades out entirely
beats.sync: secondary action — closes a pacing gap

scenes.narration: The price is that everything in it looks smaller, and your brain reads smaller as further away.
scenes.note: The trade-off. Same car, two mirrors, visibly different size — that comparison is the payoff setup.

beats.action: one car appears in both mirrors at once, at true relative size
the image in the curved mirror shrinks noticeably
a thought bubble reads the small image as distant; the real car is much closer
both mirror images hold side by side for comparison
beats.sync: secondary action — closes a pacing gap

scenes.narration: The warning exists because the mirror really is misleading you, and someone decided that had to be admitted in writing.
scenes.note: The reframe: the text is an admission, required in writing. End on the etched line.

beats.action: the real gap and the perceived gap draw together; the difference shades coral
the warning text etches permanently into the glass; hard cut
the coral gap between real and perceived distance pulses once
